== hook
#!/bin/sh
# ward-owned: codex-native-hooks v1
# Native event adapter for codex. Usage: ward.sh post, with the event JSON on stdin.
# Hooks may run in a subdirectory, so Ward always checks the project this file is in.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." || exit 2
case "$1" in
  post) exec ward hook native --agent codex --event-stdin ;;
  *) echo "Ward hook wrapper: expected post." >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
